svg.title: IDEA-003 F3 — CLA ground floor: the node tiers in plan
svg.desc: Plan cut of the CLA ground floor from the test plan: rooms, walls and doors; gold nodes and the golden channel; RBXs, Portals and Silver Rails; endpoints and the cluster boxes the IDEA-001 rule forms from them; corner cluster points.
svg.text: IDEA-003 · F3 — floor-plan cut at 1 m: CLA ground floor, all node tiers (geometry and endpoints from CLA-teszt_v2)
Gold = Elosztó, BASE and the channel between them and the RBXs · silver = RBX, Portal, Silver Rail · bronze = endpoints and the cluster boxes that house them.
R06 / R07 rails are drawn as built along the L; elsewhere the rail is shown as a link (it follows the walls at ≈ 2450).
gold nodes; the board is the only one preloaded
22 from the endpoints (≤ 300 mm, one face, one zone)
the corners the L leaves out
13 Portal nests on the 7 marked doors;
7 of them moved to the latch side.
